item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 21/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine weather to the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. It will be very hot over the coast of Guangdong. A trough of low pressure will edge closer to the coast of southern China on Saturday. There will be a few showers over the region. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, temperatures will fall slightly over the coast of Guangdong early next week. Another trough of low pressure is expected to affect southern China midweek next week. The weather will become unsettled over the region.
